title: Major CAGED Chords
description: The foundation of the system - five chord shapes that cover the entire neck.

drills.name: Major Chords
drills.description: Learn the 5 major chord shapes that make up CAGED

title: Minor CAGED Chords
description: The same five positions, reframed - learn to shift between major and minor anywhere on the neck.

drills.name: Minor Chords
drills.description: Learn the 5 minor chord shapes that make up CAGED

title: Dom7 CAGED Chords
description: The blues backbone - dominant 7th chords add tension that resolves naturally, and knowing all five shapes means you can find that sound anywhere on the neck.

drills.name: Dom7 Chords
drills.description: Learn the 5 dominant 7th chord shapes that make up CAGED

title: Major Scales & Arpeggios
description: Scales give you the full picture; arpeggios show you the chord tones inside them. Together they connect your chord shapes to every note on the neck.

drills.name: Major Scale
drills.description: Map the major scale across all 5 CAGED positions

drills.name: Major Pentatonic
drills.description: Map the major pentatonic across all 5 CAGED positions

drills.name: Major Arpeggio
drills.description: Isolate the chord tones within each major CAGED shape

title: Minor Scales & Arpeggios
description: The minor equivalents of the same five positions - essential for soloing, understanding key changes, and moving fluidly between major and minor tonality.

drills.name: Minor Scale
drills.description: Map the natural minor scale across all 5 CAGED positions

drills.name: Minor Pentatonic
drills.description: Map the minor pentatonic across all 5 CAGED positions

drills.name: Minor Arpeggio
drills.description: Isolate the chord tones within each minor CAGED shape

title: Triads
description: Triads are the three-note core of every chord - knowing where they sit inside each CAGED shape is what separates players who solo from players who just run scales.

drills.name: Major Triads
drills.description: Identify the major triad shapes within each CAGED position

drills.name: Minor Triads
drills.description: Identify the minor triad shapes within each CAGED position

title: Double Stops
description: Two notes played together - the building block of country chicken pickin', blues fills, and everything in between. Learn to find them across the neck and your playing gets texture immediately.

drills.name: Double Stops
drills.description: Locate double stop pairs across all 5 CAGED positions
